description.p: Conductor is a driver station for FIRST Robotics Competition robots on Linux and macOS. It connects to a roboRIO or the WPILib simulator, enables and disables the robot in autonomous, teleoperated and test modes, maps game controllers to joystick ports, and shows the robot console.

Conductor includes a Model Context Protocol server, so AI agents can run the driver station too: check status, run timed tests, read the console and drive a virtual joystick. By default agents may only enable the simulator, and every agent enable is timed.
Conductor is not compatible with the Field Management System and cannot be used in competition.
